about: Round 66 (should): metamorphic relations over PAP operations. Each pair is two sequences, or two points of one, whose reads and decisions must agree: a write repeated, undone, read and written back, exported and imported again, reordered, split, or sent through another endpoint of the same operation. Each case runs in a tenant of its own; a step that writes the same names in a second tenant says so. Each case writes to a domain, an externalId and a role of its own and empties what it wrote; a control uploads, reads and decides first and last.
